identity.name: Signtists Lab AI
principles: Data Density over Fluff: Sign shops manage thousands of details. Show them clearly.
High Contrast, Low Strain: Dark backgrounds with electric accents for visibility in dim workshops.
Workflow is King: Every click must save time. No decorative clicks.
Industrial Aesthetics: Use textures and fonts that remind users of the physical craft of sign making.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME SETUP: Immediately configure `tailwind.config.js` with the colors provided in this JSON. Ensure 'dark' mode is the default class applied to the html/body.
2. FONT INSTALLATION: Add the Google Fonts import link to `index.css` at the very top.
3. LAYOUT STRATEGY: Use a persistent Sidebar Layout for the app. The Sidebar should be collapsible.
4. DASHBOARD: Implement a 'Bento Grid' style dashboard. Use the 'dashboard_texture' image as a subtle overlay or background for the 'Welcome' card.
5. DATA DISPLAY: For lists (Customers, Jobs), use Shadcn Tables. Customize them to have 'zebra striping' using `even:bg-muted/50` for better readability in dark mode.
6. FORMS: Use `react-hook-form` with `zod` validation. Style inputs with the 'inputs.base' classes defined above.
7. AI TOOLS: When building the AI tools section, use the 'neon_glow' effect on the 'Generate' buttons to make them feel powerful.
8. LOGO: Use the placeholder logo URL provided in assets until the real logo is available. Place it prominently in the Sidebar header.
9. CRITICAL: Do not use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Barlow Condensed' class `font-secondary` (you need to define this in tailwind config).
10. TESTING: Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
universal_guidelines: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use grids.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for modals and sticky headers.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures and noise overlays separate good from extraordinary.
